world.title: Japan killed more than 14,000 bears between April 2025 and January 2026 after record attacks on people; despite the cull, 6 people have been killed this year and the government plans to remove another
world.summary: Japan culled over 14,000 bears from April 2025 to January 2026 due to an increase in attacks on humans. Despite this significant reduction, six fatalities occurred this year. The government is planning to eliminate an additional 8,800 bears to further address safety concerns. The situation highlights ongoing challenges related to wildlife management and human-bear interactions in Japan.

world.title: They made it: Nepali family on balcony of viral green house survives monster flood
world.summary: A Nepali family survived severe flash floods by taking refuge on the balcony of their green-painted house, which remained intact while surrounding buildings were destroyed. The house's durability became a focal point on social media, highlighting the family's remarkable escape amid the devastation. This incident underscores the resilience of certain structures in the face of natural disasters.

world.title: With Kuwait deal, Pakistan expands defence umbrella across Middle East
world.summary: Pakistan and Kuwait signed a new defence agreement, enhancing military cooperation established in 2023. This deal is part of a broader trend, as Gulf states like Saudi Arabia deepen defence ties with Pakistan. While the agreement aims to strengthen regional security, the specific benefits for Pakistan remain unclear. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif emphasized the importance of this partnership.

business.title: Skyways Air Services IPO Allotment Status Online
business.summary: Skyways Air Services will have its IPO allotment status available online via Bigshare on August 28, 2026. The company specializes in developing, manufacturing, and marketing a variety of reagents and consumables. Despite experiencing growth in its revenue, it faced challenges in other areas during the reported periods. Investors can check the allotment status on the specified date.

business.title: Lumino Industries IPO Subscription Status
business.summary: Lumino Industries' IPO subscription status is currently available on BSE and NSE platforms. The company focuses on developing, manufacturing, and marketing a variety of reagents and consumables. Despite reporting growth in its top lines during recent periods, it experienced setbacks in other areas. Investors can track the latest subscription figures and performance updates for the IPO.

business.title: India's forex reserves jump $12.42 billion to record high of $729.33 billion
business.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported a $12.42 billion increase in its foreign exchange reserves, reaching a record high of $729.33 billion for the week ending August 21. This rise in reserves is attributed to strong dollar inflows, which bolster India's external financial position. The data was released by the central bank on Friday.

technology.title: Samsung's New Portable SSDs Look Great but Cost Up to $2,700
technology.summary: Samsung has introduced two new portable USB4 SSDs, the P7 and P9, which offer high-speed performance. Both models promise similar peak speeds, but the P9 provides better sustained performance. Despite the fluctuating flash memory market, Samsung aims to set a new performance benchmark with these drives, which are priced up to $2,700.

technology.title: Hugging Face Unveils $400 Duck-Like Robot That Can Sing and Skate
technology.summary: Hugging Face Inc. has launched a $400 bipedal robot named "Ducky," capable of singing and performing tricks. This release aims to make AI and robotics more accessible to the public. The announcement follows reports that Nvidia Corp. is close to acquiring Hugging Face for approximately $13 billion. The robot represents a significant step in consumer-friendly AI technology.

technology.title: iPhone 17 Pro Max, 17 Pro price drops days before iPhone 18 Pro India launch event
technology.summary: Flipkart has reduced prices for the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max ahead of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro launch event on September 9 in India. The price cuts provide consumers with an opportunity to purchase the current Pro models at lower prices. This move enhances the choice between the compact Pro and the larger Pro Max.

sports.title: Barcelona rejected chance to sign Real Madrid summer signing due to €25 million release clause - report
sports.summary: Barcelona reportedly declined the opportunity to sign Carlos Espi, who has since joined Real Madrid, due to his €25 million release clause. The club is actively seeking a new striker, but Espi's potential transfer was not pursued. The information comes from SPORT, highlighting Barcelona's ongoing challenges in securing a suitable number nine during the summer transfer window.

sports.title: ‘People don’t always know the real story’: Sjoerd Marijne responds to questions over pre-World Cup leave
sports.summary: India women’s hockey team chief coach Sjoerd Marijne has defended his decision to take leave prior to the FIH World Cup. He stated that his absence did not hinder the team’s preparations and emphasized that he remained involved in the process. Marijne expressed that people may not fully understand the circumstances surrounding his leave.

sports.title: Road to UFC Season 5 semifinal in Shanghai, Live Updates: Rabindra Dhant vs Kasib Murdoch underway
sports.summary: Rabindra Dhant is competing against unbeaten Kasib Murdoch in the semifinal of Road to UFC Season 5 in Shanghai. The fight has commenced, with Murdoch attempting a leg lock while Dhant counters with jabs. Dhant later attempts a submission, but Murdoch successfully escapes the choke. Live updates are available as the match progresses, marking a significant moment for Dhant.

health.title: The caesarean conversation needs a nutrition lens
health.summary: India's Caesarean section birth rates have risen significantly, reaching 21.5% according to the National Family Health Survey-5. This marks an increase from 17.2% in NFHS-4 and 8.5% in NFHS-3 over the past decade. Experts suggest that addressing nutritional factors may be crucial in understanding and potentially mitigating this trend in C-section deliveries.

health.title: Congress Interview: Raksha Jain
health.summary: Raksha Jain discusses the significant impact of cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) modulators on the cystic fibrosis (CF) field during an interview following her receipt of the American Thoracic Society (ATS) John W. Walsh Award. She reflects on her career and highlights the importance of her scientific contributions to advancing CF treatment and understanding.

health.title: Frankfurt Airport steps up mosquito checks after two workers die of malaria
health.summary: German health authorities are addressing public concerns after two workers at Frankfurt Airport died from malaria tropica, part of a rare outbreak. Six workers have contracted the disease, prompting investigations. In response, mosquito traps have been installed throughout the airport to monitor and control the situation. Officials are working to ensure safety and prevent further infections.

science.title: Trump to award Artemis II crew with Congressional Space Medal of Honor
science.summary: President Donald Trump will award the Congressional Space Medal of Honor to the four astronauts of NASA's Artemis II mission during a ceremony at Johnson Space Center on Friday. The crew completed a mission around the moon earlier this year, marking a significant achievement in space exploration. The honor recognizes their contributions to advancing human spaceflight.

science.title: Fungi could bring future clothes to life
science.summary: Researchers are exploring the potential of living textiles made from caterpillar fungus. Fungal mycelium, a renewable material, typically loses its living properties during processing. A recent study published in Science Advances, led by Zhong Chang, suggests that maintaining these properties could enable textiles to grow, repair themselves, and respond to environmental changes, paving the way for innovative clothing designs.

science.title: Trump to honor Artemis II astronauts with Congressional Space Medal
science.summary: President Donald Trump will honor the Artemis II astronauts with the Congressional Space Medal of Honor. The astronauts, Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen, are recognized for being the first crew in decades to travel deep into space. The awards ceremony will take place at a yet-to-be-specified location.

entertainment.title: 'Actresses never get the same hotel rooms or cars': Taapsee Pannu opens up on gender bias in the film industry, recalls being 'a minority' and 'weird situations' on sets of debut film
entertainment.summary: Taapsee Pannu discussed gender bias in the film industry, highlighting her experiences as a minority during her early career. She recalled facing unequal treatment, such as not receiving the same hotel rooms or cars as her male counterparts. Pannu emphasized the "weird situations" she encountered on set, reflecting on the broader issues of gender inequality within the industry.

entertainment.title: Exclusive: Aamir Khan, Sidharth Malhotra and Tiger Shroff in talks with Ramesh Taurani for Race Reboot
entertainment.summary: Aamir Khan is in discussions with producer Ramesh Taurani for a reboot of the Race franchise. Sidharth Malhotra and Tiger Shroff are also reportedly involved, having heard the script and expressed interest. The project aims to revitalize the popular series, which has garnered a significant following. Further details about the reboot's production and release remain undisclosed.

entertainment.title: 'Regulations should be tightened': K Annamalai slams censor board over Yash's film 'Toxic'
entertainment.summary: Former BJP leader K Annamalai criticized the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) for approving actor Yash's film 'Toxic.' He expressed concerns regarding the film's depiction of women and violence, calling for stricter regulations on film content. Annamalai's remarks were made during a press conference in Coimbatore, highlighting ongoing debates about censorship and representation in Indian cinema.
